Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning clinical review criteria used by insurers or utilization review entities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to clinical review criteria used by insurers orutilization review entities; and adding a new section to chapter 48.43RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The clinical review criteria used by an insurer or a utilizationreview entity acting on its behalf shall: (1) Adhere to the federalfood and drug administration prescription drug labeling; and (2) notrequire failure on the same American hospital formulary servicemedication class on more than one occasion for patients continuouslyenrolled in any plan offered by said insurer. Nothing in this sectionmay be construed to prevent health care providers from prescribing amedication for an offlabel use or from prescribing a medication onmore than one occasion when they determine it is medically appropriate.
